usage: Evaluator-only seeded defect units. Never copy this file into a trial workspace. Additional demonstrated defects require independent adjudication.

tracker.expected: A successful save creates a retrievable record; success feedback must match the committed outcome.
A saved record survives the fixture's documented refresh transition.
Repeated submission of the same action does not create an unintended duplicate.

owner-notes.expected: A signed-in user cannot retrieve another owner's note by identifier.
A signed-in user cannot update another owner's note by identifier.

dashboard.expected: Core dashboard tasks remain reachable without harmful horizontal clipping at the documented mobile viewport.
A failed data load has a visible error state and a usable recovery path.
The documented local filter action meets its repeatable fixture budget without an artificial blocking delay.

preservation_controls: Previously passing functional scenarios still pass.
Approved desktop/login appearance remains unchanged where fixture evidence defines it.
No unrelated dependency, feature, architecture or UI refactor is introduced.
